narrative:
Scioto County has 42,708 registered voters, with 15.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 53.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 27.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.2% of registrants.
